name: Financial Instrument Reporting Non Equity Trading Activity Report V 01
definition: The FinancialInstrumentReportingNonEquityTradingActivityReport message is sent by the trading venue to the national competent authority to report on non-equity specific trading activity aggregated quantitative data, used for the transparency calculations.

ReportHeader.name: Report Header
ReportHeader.definition: Header information related to the global report.

NonEquityTransparencyData.name: Non Equity Transparency Data
NonEquityTransparencyData.definition: Details the transparency data reported by a trading venue.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
